Line.zh: 你的伙伴准备去觅食，承诺一旦找到足够的食物或在天黑前就会回来。
Line.en: Your partner prepares to go foraging and promises to return once enough food has been found or before it gets dark.
Line.ja: Your partner prepares to go foraging and promises to return once enough food has been found or before it gets dark.
